name: HealthAdminBench
intro: HealthAdminBench 是一个医疗行政 computer-use agent 基准。135 个专家任务在 4 个确定性 GUI 环境中复现事前授权、拒付申诉和耐用医疗设备流程，并以 1,698 个可验证子任务同时衡量细粒度进展与严格的端到端任务成功。

scale: 135 个任务, 1,698 个子任务（1,177 确定性 + 521 自由文本）

eval_feature_en: Deterministic GUI, Persistent State, Strict End-to-end Scoring
intro_en: HealthAdminBench evaluates healthcare-administration computer-use agents with 135 expert-designed tasks in four deterministic GUI environments. Prior authorization, appeals and denials, and durable medical equipment workflows are decomposed into 1,698 verifiable subtasks, supporting both granular progress measurement and strict end-to-end task success.
metric_en: Task Success Rate, Subtask Success Rate, 95% Bootstrap Confidence Intervals

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.09937, Sections 2-4 and the official som-shahlab/health-admin-bench repository. Practicing healthcare administrators designed 135 prior-authorization, appeals/denials, and durable-medical-equipment tasks after more than 100 hours of workflow shadowing. The benchmark implements an EHR, two payer portals, and fax as deterministic GUI environments with synthetic patient data, typed schemas, policy checks, failure modes, and persistent state while abstracting CAPTCHA, MFA, and session management. A stratified 40-task audit uses two revenue-cycle experts per task, with corrections propagated across the set. The 135 tasks contain 1,698 subtasks across six capability groups: 1,177 deterministic JMESPath checks and 521 GPT-5.4 free-text judges, whose 60-sample expert agreement is 93.3%. Subtasks are binary, and strict task success requires every subtask to pass; reporting includes subtask and task success with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
